title: Semi-quantitative group testing for efficient and accurate qPCR screening of pathogens with a wide range of loads
summary: A group testing scheme for qPCR pathogen screening that handles viral loads spanning several orders of magnitude, with theoretical guarantees on the number of tests required.
authors: Ananthan Nambiar; Chao Pan; Vishal Rana; Mahdi Cheraghchi; João Ribeiro; Sergei Maslov; Olgica Milenkovic
